name: 78132 · New Braunfels, TX
findings: ZIP 78132 (New Braunfels) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78132 (New Braunfels) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78132 (New Braunfels) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
